  --root "$PWD" --oracle "$out/oracle-build/kicad-oracle" --rust "$bin/kicad-vector-shim" \
  --report "$out/compare-vector.json"

steps.name: Compare every public case exactly and replay the controls on both sides
steps.run:
out="$RUNNER_TEMP/core-native"
oracle="$out/oracle-build/kicad-oracle"
# The header bodies are compiled from the pinned headers into the adapter; the
# scripted clock wrapper and the dependency unit's observable bodies are linked.
nm -C "$oracle" > "$out/symbols.txt"
for symbol in 'KI_MST::FilterKruskal<' 'KI_UNION_FIND::Unite' 'PROF_TIMER::to_string[' \
              'UTIL::DETAIL::OBSERVABLE_BASE::leave_iteration()' 'LATENCY_PROBE::to_string[' \
              '__wrap__ZNSt6chrono3_V212system_clock3nowEv' '__wrap_clock_gettime'; do
  grep -F -- "$symbol" "$out/symbols.txt" > /dev/null || { echo "missing $symbol"; exit 1; }
done
rust/target/debug/kicad-difftest compare --unit "$UNIT" --root "$PWD" \
  --oracle "$oracle" --rust "$PWD/rust/target/debug/kicad-core-include-shim" \
  --report "$out/compare.json"
python3 -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); print({k: r[k] for k in ("status","cases","compared","deferred","failures","unprocessed")})' "$out/compare.json"
python3 port/oracle/test_core_include_p001_inputs.py "$oracle" "$PWD/rust/target/debug/kicad-core-include-shim"
"$oracle" < "port/cases/$UNIT.jsonl" > "$out/native.jsonl"

steps.name: Replay the complete corpus in import-free WebAssembly against the C++ replies
steps.run:

  --example corpus_parity --features live-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release -j2
node rust/kicad-core-include-shim/wasm-test.mjs rust/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/examples/corpus_parity.wasm

steps.run:

python3 -c 'import json,sys; p=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in p.items() if "wx" in k.lower() or "compiler" in k.lower()}, indent=1)[:4000])' "$out/provenance.json"
rust/target/debug/kicad-difftest compare --partial --unit "$UNIT" --root "$PWD" \
  --oracle "$oracle" --rust "$PWD/rust/target/debug/kicad-vector2wx-shim" \
  --report "$out/compare.json"
python3 -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); print({k: r[k] for k in ("status","cases","compared","deferred","failures","unprocessed")})' "$out/compare.json"
python3 port/oracle/test_vector2wx_inputs.py "$oracle" "$PWD/rust/target/debug/kicad-vector2wx-shim"
